# Huang's Blog

> Personal blog of Huang Lizhuo — projects and notes on things he builds and learns. Bilingual: English (default, unprefixed URLs) and Chinese (under /zh/).

Author: Huang Lizhuo
- GitHub: https://github.com/huanglizhuo
- X: https://x.com/huang4fun

## Pages

- [Home](https://blog.clothpath.com/): About the author and featured projects
- [Posts](https://blog.clothpath.com/posts/): All blog posts (English)
- [Projects](https://blog.clothpath.com/projects/): Project pages with facts and FAQs (English)
- [About](https://blog.clothpath.com/about/): About the author and his projects
- [首页](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/): 中文版首页
- [文章](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/posts/): 全部文章（中文）
- [项目](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/projects/): 项目介绍（中文，含事实表与 FAQ）
- [关于](https://blog.clothpath.com/zh/about/): 关于作者（中文）

## Projects

- [EchoPod](https://blog.clothpath.com/projects/echopod/): Language learning app built around AI subtitles for podcasts. Official site: https://echopod.clothpath.com/
- [OctoCounts](https://blog.clothpath.com/projects/octocounts/): Free SLOC counter for public GitHub repositories (web app + browser extension). Official site: https://octocounts.com/
- [FuseBar](https://blog.clothpath.com/projects/fusebar/): Free native macOS menu bar app for system status, running apps, and project shortcuts. Repo: https://github.com/huanglizhuo/FuseBar
- [Ketsuin 結印](https://blog.clothpath.com/projects/ketsuin/): Web-based input method using ninja hand signs detected in the browser. Official site: https://ketsuin.clothpath.com/
- [QwenASR](https://blog.clothpath.com/projects/qwenasr/): Pure-Rust, CPU-only inference engine for Qwen3-ASR speech-to-text. Repo: https://github.com/huanglizhuo/QwenASR
